Greg Ferguson

Greg Ferguson profile image

About the author

Greg Ferguson moved to Tucson 54 years ago. He served as a paratrooper with the 82nd Airborne Division. He has a bachelor’s degree in Political Science from Arizona State University and a Master’s degree in Systems Engineering from the University of Arizona. He has worked as an Aerospace Engineer in Tucson for the last 32 years.
Greg is married and his son is also an Engineer. Greg enjoys hunting, hiking, motorcycle riding and amateur astronomy. He has published a novel, a textbook and numerous technical articles.
